name: shipyard
description: Triage into full shipyard or lighter boatyard, then plan, adversarially review, implement in parallel worktrees, polish, review again, ship. Bundles the astra, sol, fable, opus, simplifier, codex, opus-reviewer, sonnet-reviewer, sonnet-implementer, guest-implementer (Gemini 4 Neon via Antigravity), opt-in mythos and grok reviewers (warn-only when unavailable), the workflow skill that drives them, and /shipyard:doctor to check the CLIs they delegate to.
